rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Restriction of Special Taxation Act and its Enforcement Decree , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended Mar. 11, 2005>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Restriction on Special Cases concerning Taxation and the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Restriction on Special Cases concerning Taxation, as well as matters necessary for their implementation. <Amended Mar. 11, 2005>

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Scope of Small and Medium Enterprises) ① Deleted <Mar. 17, 2017>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Small and Medium Enterprises) ① Deleted <Mar. 17, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② Deleted <March 13, 2015>
rows.text_en: ② Deleted <March 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ Deleted <March 13, 2015>
rows.text_en: ③ Deleted <March 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ④ Sales revenue under Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be the sales revenue on the income statement for the relevant tax year prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles as of the end of the tax year. However, in the case of a business establishment, division, or merger, it refers to the amount calculated by converting the sales revenue of the tax year to which the day following the date of registration (or the date of establishment in the case of a business establishment) falls into an annual sales revenue. <Newly added Mar. 28, 2001; Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 13, 2015; Mar. 17, 2017; Mar. 13, 2020>
rows.text_en: (4) The sales revenue referred to in Article 2(1)1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Restriction on Special Cases concerning Taxation (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be the sales revenue shown on the income statement for the relevant taxable year, prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles as of the end of that taxable year. Provided, That in the case of a start-up, division, or merger, it means the amount obtained by annualizing the sales revenue for the taxable year in which the day following the date of registration (or the date of commencement of business, in the case of a start-up) falls. <Newly Inserted Mar. 28, 2001; Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 13, 2015; Mar. 17, 2017; Mar. 13, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The total assets pursuant to the proviso in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be the total assets on the balance sheet prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles as of the end of the tax year. <Newly added Mar. 24, 2003; Feb. 28, 2012; Feb. 23, 2013; Mar. 13, 2015>
rows.text_en: (5) The total assets referred to in the proviso to the part of Article 2(1) of the Decree other than its subparagraphs shall be the total assets shown on the balance sheet prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles as of the end of the relevant taxable year. <Newly Inserted Mar. 24, 2003; Feb. 28, 2012; Feb. 23, 2013; Mar. 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ Deleted <March 13, 2015>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Deleted <March 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ Article 2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Adjustment of International Taxation shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the indirect ownership ratio of issued shares pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree. <Newly added Apr. 29, 2008; Mar. 16, 2021>
rows.text_en: (7) Article 2(3) of the Enforcement Decree of the Adjustment of International Taxes Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the indirect ownership ratio of issued shares under Article 2(4) of the Decree. <Newly Inserted Apr. 29, 2008; Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ The determination of whether an enterprise belongs to the category of related enterprises pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 , Item (c) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises, pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree , shall be based on the date of the end of the tax year. <Newly added Mar. 14, 2014>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The determination of whether an enterprise belongs to the category of related enterprises pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 , Item (c) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises, pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree , shall be based on the date of the end of the tax year. <Newly added Mar. 14, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ The total assets of a foreign corporation pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item (b) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises, pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree , shall be the amount calculated by converting the total assets denominated in foreign currency on the balance sheet prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles as of the end of the relevant tax year using the standard exchange rate as of the end of the relevant tax year (referring to the standard exchange rate pursuant to the regulations on foreign exchange transactions prescribed and notified by the Minister of Finance and Economy ). <Newly added Mar. 22, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The total assets of a foreign corporation pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item (b) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises, pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree , shall be the amount calculated by converting the total assets denominated in foreign currency on the balance sheet prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles as of the end of the relevant tax year using the standard exchange rate as of the end of the relevant tax year (referring to the standard exchange rate pursuant to the regulations on foreign exchange transactions prescribed and notified by the Minister of Finance and Economy ). <Newly added Mar. 22, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026>
Article 3 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(금융리스의 범위) 영 제3조에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 금융리스”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우의 자산 대여(이하 “리스”라 한다)를 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Scope of Finance Leases) In Article 3 of the Decree, the term “finance lease prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a lease of an asset falling under any of the following cases (hereinafter referred to as a “lease”). <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 리스기간[계약해지금지조건이 부가된 기간(명시적인 계약해지금지조건은 없으나 실질적으로 계약해지금지조건이 부가된 것으로 볼 수 있는 기간을 포함한다)을 말하며, 기간 종료시점에서 계약해지금지조건이 부가된 갱신계약의 약정이 있는 경우에는 그 약정에 따른 기간을 포함한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다] 종료 시 또는 그 이전에 리스이용자에게 해당 리스의 자산(이하 이 조에서 “리스자산”이라 한다)의 소유권을 무상 또는 당초 계약 시 정한 금액으로 이전할 것을 약정한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Where it has been agreed to transfer ownership of the asset under the relevant lease (hereinafter referred to as the “lease asset”) to the lessee free of charge or at the amount stipulated at the time of the original contract upon or prior to the termination of the lease period [referring to a period to which a condition prohibiting termination is attached (including a period to which there is no explicit condition prohibiting termination but which can be substantially deemed to have such condition attached); and if there is an agreement for a renewal contract to which a condition prohibiting termination is attached at the time of the expiration of the period, it includes the period pursuant to such agreement. The same shall apply hereinafter in this Article]

rows.source_ko: 2. 리스기간 종료 시 리스자산을 취득가액의 100분의 10 이하의 금액으로 구매할 수 있는 권리가 리스실행일 현재 리스이용자에게 주어진 경우 또는 취득가액의 100분의 10 이하의 금액을 갱신계약의 원금으로 하여 리스계약을 갱신할 수 있는 권리가 리스실행일 현재 리스이용자에게 주어진 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where the lessee is granted the right to purchase the leased asset at the end of the lease term for an amount not exceeding 10% of the acquisition cost as of the lease execution date, or where the lessee is granted the right to renew the lease agreement with an amount not exceeding 10% of the acquisition cost as the principal of the renewal agreement as of the lease execution date

rows.source_ko: 3. 리스기간이 「법인세법 시행규칙」 별표 5 및 별표 6에 규정된 리스자산의 자산별ㆍ업종별(리스이용자의 업종에 의한다) 기준내용연수의 100분의 75 이상인 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Where the lease term is 75/100 or more of the standard useful life by asset type and industry (based on the lessee’s industry), as prescribed in Attached Tables 5 and 6 to the Enforcement Rule of the Corporate Tax Act.

rows.source_ko: 4. 리스실행일 현재 최소리스료를 기업회계기준에 따라 현재가치로 평가한 가액이 해당 리스자산의 장부가액의 100분의 90 이상인 경우
rows.text_en: 4. If, as of the lease execution date, the present value of the minimum lease payments assessed in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles is 90% or more of the book value of the leased asset

rows.source_ko: 5. 리스자산의 용도가 리스이용자만의 특정 목적에 한정되어 있고, 다른 용도로의 전용(轉用)에 과다한 비용이 발생하여 사실상 전용이 불가능한 경우
rows.text_en: 5. Cases where the use of the leased asset is limited to a specific purpose exclusive to the lessee, and diversion to another use is practically impossible due to excessive costs.
[This Article Newly Inserted April 7, 2011]
Article 4 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(제조업의 범위) 영 제5조제6항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 자기가 제품을 직접 제조하지 아니하고 제조업체(사업장이 국내 또는 「개성공업지구 지원에 관한 법률」 제2조제1호에 따른 개성공업지구에 소재하는 업체에 한정한다)에 의뢰하여 제조하는 사업으로서 그 사업이 다음 각 호의 요건을 충족하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Scope of Manufacturing Business) In Article 5(6) of the Decree, the term “business prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a business in which a company does not manufacture products itself but commissions a manufacturing company (limited to a company whose place of business is located in Korea or the Kaesong Industrial Complex under Article 2(1) of the Act on Support for the Kaesong Industrial Complex) to manufacture them, provided that the business satisfies the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생산할 제품을 직접 기획(고안ㆍ디자인 및 견본제작 등을 말한다)할 것
rows.text_en: 1. Directly plan the product to be produced (referring to conception, design, and prototype production, etc.).

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 제품을 자기명의로 제조할 것
rows.text_en: 2. Manufacture the product under your own name.

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 제품을 인수하여 자기책임하에 직접 판매할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Take possession of the product and sell it directly under your own responsibility.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 17, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의3(창업중소기업 등에 대한 세액감면 적용 시 신성장 서비스업의 범위) 영 제5조제12항제7호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 신성장 서비스업”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사업을 말한다. <개정 2020. 3. 13., 2024. 3. 22., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-3 (Scope of New Growth Service Industries for Application of Tax Reductions for Start-Up SMEs, etc.) In Article 5(12)7 of the Decree, the term “new growth service industries prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to any business falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 22, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「전시산업발전법」 제2조제1호에 따른 전시산업
rows.text_en: 1. Exhibition industry pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Exhibition Industry Development Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 기타 과학기술 서비스업
rows.text_en: 2. Other scientific and technological services

rows.source_ko: 3. 시장조사 및 여론조사업
rows.text_en: 3. Market Research and Public Opinion Survey Business

rows.source_ko: 4. 광고업 중 광고대행업, 옥외 및 전시 광고업
rows.text_en: 4. Advertising business, including advertising agency business and outdoor and exhibition advertising business
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 21, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(소기업의 매출액) 영 제6조제4항에 따른 매출액은 제2조제4항에 따른 매출액으로 한다. <개정 2025. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Sales Revenue of Small Enterprises) Sales revenue pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be the sales revenue pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 4. <Amended June 30, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 17, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(무상임대 자산의 범위) 영 제7조의2제6항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 자산”이란 제13조의11제1항제1호에 해당하는 자산을 말한다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2021. 3. 16., 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Scope of Assets Subject to Gratuitous Lease) In Article 7-2, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “assets prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to assets falling under Article 13-11, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 16, 2021; Jan. 2, 2026; Mar. 20, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 17, 2017]
Article 6 Deleted <Mar. 17, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(연구 및 인력개발비의 범위) ①영 별표 6 제1호가목1)가)부터 다)까지 외의 부분 본문에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 연구소 또는 전담부서”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 연구소 및 전담부서(이하 “전담부서등”이라 한다)를 말하며, 영 별표 6 제1호가목1)가)부터 다)까지 외의 부분 본문에 따른 연구개발서비스업이란 「연구산업진흥법」에 따른 전문연구사업자가 영위하는 같은 법 제2조제1호가목의 연구산업(이하 이 조에서 “연구개발서비스업”이라 한다)을 말한다. <개정 2008. 4. 29., 2009. 4. 7., 2009. 8. 28., 2010. 4. 20., 2011. 4. 7., 2012. 2. 28., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 3. 14., 2015. 3. 13., 2017. 3. 17., 2019. 3. 20., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Scope of Research and Human Resource Development Expenses) (1) In the main text of item 1(a)1) of Annex 6 to the Decree, excluding items (a) through (c), the term “research institute or dedicated department prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a research institute or dedicated department falling under any of the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as “dedicated department, etc.”); and the term “research and development service business” in the main text of item 1(a)1) of Annex 6 to the Decree, excluding items (a) through (c), refers to the research industry under Article 2(1)(a) of the Research Industry Promotion Act, which is operated by a specialized research business operator under the same Act (hereinafter referred to as “research and development service business” in this Article). <Amended Apr. 29, 2008; Apr. 7, 2009; Aug. 28, 2009; Apr. 20, 2010; Apr. 7, 2011; Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Mar. 14, 2014; Mar. 13, 2015; Mar. 17, 2017; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「기초연구진흥 및 기술개발지원에 관한 법률」 제14조의2제1항에 따라 과학기술정보통신부장관의 인정을 받은 기업부설연구소 또는 연구개발전담부서
rows.text_en: 1. A corporate research institute or R&D department recognized by the Minister of Science and ICT pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Promotion of Basic Research and Support for Technology Development

rows.source_ko: 2. 「문화산업진흥 기본법」 제17조의3제1항에 따른 기업부설창작연구소 또는 기업창작전담부서
rows.text_en: 2. A corporate creative research institute or a corporate creative department pursuant to Article 17-3, Paragraph 1 of the Framework Act on the Promotion of Cultural Industries

rows.source_ko: 3. 「산업디자인진흥법」 제9조에 따른 산업디자인전문회사(이하 이 조에서 “산업디자인전문회사”라 한다)
rows.text_en: 3. An industrial design company pursuant to Article 9 of the Industrial Design Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as “industrial design company” in this Article)

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제9조제3항제1호가목 및 같은 조 제7항제1호가목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 연구소 또는 전담부서”란 각각 전담부서등 및 연구개발서비스업을 영위하는 기업을 말한다. <개정 2025. 3. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: (2) In Article 9(3)1(a) and Article 9(7)1(a) of the Decree, the term “research institute or dedicated department prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to dedicated departments, etc., and enterprises engaged in research and development service business, respectively. <Amended Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③영 별표 6 제1호가목1)가)부터 다)까지 외의 부분 본문에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 자”란 전담부서등에서 연구업무에 종사하는 「기초연구진흥 및 기술개발지원에 관한 법률 시행령」에 따른 연구전담요원(산업디자인전문회사의 경우 연구업무에 종사하는 「산업디자인진흥법 시행규칙」 제9조제1항제1호에 따른 전문인력을 말한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다) 및 「기초연구진흥 및 기술개발지원에 관한 법률 시행령」에 따른 연구보조원과 연구개발서비스업에 종사하는 전담요원을 말한다. 다만, 주주인 임원으로서 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자는 제외한다. <개정 2008. 4. 29., 2009. 4. 7., 2010. 4. 20., 2011. 4. 7., 2012. 2. 28., 2014. 3. 14., 2019. 3. 20., 2021. 3. 16., 2022. 3. 18., 2025. 3. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: (3) In the main text of item 1(a)1) of Annex 6 to the Decree, excluding items (a) through (c), the term “persons prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to research personnel engaged in research work in dedicated departments, etc. pursuant to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Promotion of Basic Research and Support for Technology Development (in the case of specialized industrial design companies, this refers to professional personnel engaged in research work pursuant to Article 9(1)1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Industrial Design Promotion Act; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) and research assistants pursuant to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Promotion of Basic Research and Support for Technology Development, as well as dedicated personnel engaged in research and development service businesses. Provided, That executives who are shareholders and fall under any of the following subparagraphs shall be excluded. <Amended Apr. 29, 2008; Apr. 7, 2009; Apr. 20, 2010; Apr. 7, 2011; Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 14, 2014; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 16, 2021; Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.text_en: 2. Shareholders of the relevant corporation who are controlling shareholders, etc. pursuant to Article 43, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Corporate Tax Act , and shareholders owning more than 10 percent of the total issued shares of the relevant corporation.

rows.source_ko: 3. 제2호에 해당하는 자(법인을 포함한다)의 「소득세법 시행령」 제98조제1항 또는 「법인세법 시행령」 제2조제8항에 따른 특수관계인. 이 경우 「법인세법 시행령」 제2조제8항제7호에 해당하는 자가 해당 법인의 임원인 경우를 제외한다.

In this case, cases where a person falling under subparagraph 7 of Article 2, Paragraph 8 of the Enforcement Decree of the Corporate Tax Act is an executive of the relevant corporation are excluded.

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제9조제3항제1호가목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사람”이란 영 별표 7에 따른 신성장ㆍ원천기술의 연구개발업무(이하 이 조에서 “신성장ㆍ원천기술연구개발업무”라 한다)와 영 별표 7의2에 따른 국가전략기술의 연구개발업무(이하 이 조에서 “국가전략기술연구개발업무”라 한다) 또는 일반연구개발업무를 동시에 수행한 사람으로서 신성장ㆍ원천기술연구개발업무 근무시간 및 국가전략기술연구개발업무 근무시간이 전체 연구개발업무 근무시간의 100분의 50 이하인 사람을 말한다. <개정 2025. 3. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ In Article 9, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1, Item ( a) of the Enforcement Decree , the term “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a person who simultaneously performs research and development work for new growth and source technologies pursuant to Annex 7 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “new growth and source technology research and development work” in this Article), research and development work for national strategic technologies pursuant to Annex 7-2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “national strategic technology research and development work” in this Article), or general research and development work, wherein the working hours for the new growth and source technology research and development work and the working hours for national strategic technology research and development work constitute 50% or less of the total working hours for research and development work. <Amended Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

⑤ In subparagraph 1(d) of Annex 6 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “expenses prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to technical consulting fees paid for receiving advice on industrial technology from any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Apr. 29, 2008; Apr. 7, 2009; Apr. 20, 2010; Apr. 7, 2011; Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 13, 2015; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

Researchers directly engaged in research work at national or public research institutes conducting research in the field of science and technology, government-funded research institutes, domestic or foreign non-profit corporations (including affiliated research institutes), specialized production technology research institutes pursuant to Article 42 of the Industrial Technology Innovation Promotion Act, domestic or foreign research institutes established by companies, dedicated departments, etc., or research institutes affiliated with foreign companies.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「고등교육법」 제2조에 따른 대학(교육대학 및 사범대학을 포함한다) 또는 전문대학에 근무하는 과학기술분야의 교수(조교수 이상인 자에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Professors in the field of science and technology working at universities (including colleges of education and teacher training colleges) or junior colleges pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act (limited to those holding the rank of assistant professor or higher)

rows.source_ko: 3. 외국에서 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 산업분야에 5년 이상 종사하였거나 학사학위 이상의 학력을 가지고 해당 분야에 3년 이상 종사한 외국인기술자
rows.text_en: 3. Foreign technicians who have worked for at least 5 years in any of the industrial fields listed in the following subparagraphs abroad, or who hold a bachelor's degree or higher and have worked in the relevant field for at least 3 years.

rows.text_en: f. Market research and public opinion surveying, management consulting and public relations services, business facility maintenance services, education-related advisory and evaluation services, other education support services (limited to the operation of exchange student programs, etc.), non-financial holding companies, technical testing, inspection and analysis services, surveying services, drafting services, geological survey and exploration services (limited to geological survey and exploration activities excluding survey and exploration for the purpose of mineral extraction), mapmaking services, professional design services, other unclassified professional, scientific, and technical services (limited to other unclassified professional, scientific, and technical services excluding mapmaking and environmental cleanup and restoration activities), other mining support services (limited to mineral exploration activities for the purpose of extraction), soil and groundwater cleanup services (limited to soil and groundwater cleanup activities), and other environmental cleanup and restoration services [limited to environmental cleanup activities other than soil and groundwater (excluding the collection and transportation of oil spilled from ships)].

rows.source_ko: 1. 인건비에 해당하는 공통비용의 경우

rows.source_ko: 가. 영 별표 6 제1호가목1)에 따른 직원 및 전담요원의 근무시간을 신성장ㆍ원천기술개발업무, 국가전략기술개발업무 및 일반연구개발업무로 각각 구분하여 기록ㆍ관리한 경우
rows.text_en: a. Cases where the working hours of employees and dedicated personnel pursuant to Item 1, Subparagraph (a) 1) of Annex 6 of the Enforcement Decree are recorded and managed by classifying them into new growth and source technology development work, national strategic technology development work, and general research and development work, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 1) 일반연구개발업무 근무시간이 전체 연구개발업무 근무시간의 100분의 50 미만인 경우: 전체 인건비를 신성장ㆍ원천기술개발업무 근무시간, 국가전략기술개발업무 근무시간 및 일반연구개발업무 근무시간으로 각각 안분한 비용. 이 경우 국가전략기술연구개발업무 근무시간이 전체 연구개발업무 근무시간의 100분의 50 이하인 사람의 국가전략기술연구개발업무 근무시간은 신성장ㆍ원천기술개발업무 근무시간으로 본다.
rows.text_en: 1) In cases where working hours for general research and development work are less than 50% of the total working hours for research and development work: The total personnel costs allocated by proportionally dividing them among working hours for new growth and source technology development work, working hours for national strategic technology development work, and working hours for general research and development work, respectively. In this case, the working hours for national strategic technology research and development work of a person whose working hours for national strategic technology research and development work are 50% or less of the total working hours for research and development work shall be deemed as working hours for new growth and source technology development work.

rows.source_ko: 2) 일반연구개발업무 근무시간이 전체 연구개발업무 근무시간의 100분의 50 이상인 경우: 전액 일반연구개발비
rows.text_en: 2) If working hours for general R&D work account for 50% or more of the total working hours for R&D work: The entire amount is general R&D expenses

rows.source_ko: 나. 영 별표 6 제1호가목1)에 따른 직원 및 전담요원의 근무시간을 국가전략기술개발업무, 신성장ㆍ원천기술개발업무 및 일반연구개발업무로 구분할 수 없는 경우: 전액 일반연구개발비
rows.text_en: b. 제1호 및 제2호 × 영 제9조제3항제1호가목의 비용 
 외의 공통비용

rows.text_en: b. Expenses for R&D on national strategic technologies: expenses calculated according to the following formula.

rows.source_ko:
제1호 및 제2호 × 영 제9조제7항제1호가목의 비용 
 외의 공통비용 
 영 제9조제3항제1호가목의 비용 + 같은 조 제7항제1호가목의 비용 + 
 일반연구ㆍ인력개발비 중 영 별표 6 제1호가목1) 및 2)에 해당하는 비 
 용
rows.text_en: Common expenses other than those under Subparagraphs 1 and 2 × [Expenses under Article 9(7)1(a) of the Enforcement Decree / (Expenses under Article 9(3)1(a) + Expenses under Article 9(7)1(a) + Expenses under items 1 and 2 of subparagraph 1(a) of Attached Table 6 of the Enforcement Decree within general research and human resources development expenses)].

rows.source_ko: 다. 일반연구ㆍ인력개발비: 제1호 및 제2호 외의 공통비용에서 가목 및 나목의 비용을 제외한 비용
rows.text_en: c. General R&D and human resource development expenses: expenses other than the common expenses specified in subparagraphs 1 and 2, excluding the expenses under items (a) and (b).

rows.source_ko: ⑰ 법 제10조제1항을 적용받으려는 내국인은 해당 과세연도에 수행한 연구개발 과제별로 별지 제3호의2서식에 따른 연구개발계획서, 연구개발보고서 및 연구노트를 작성(법 제10조제1항제3호를 적용받는 경우에는 연구개발계획서 및 연구개발보고서만 작성한다)하고 해당 과세연도의 종료일로부터 5년 동안 보관해야 한다. <신설 2019. 3. 20., 2022. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: 17. A domestic national who intends to be subject to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall prepare a research and development plan, a research and development report, and a research notebook in accordance with Form No. 3-2 for each research and development project performed during the relevant tax year (in cases subject to Article 10, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act , only the research and development plan and the research and development report shall be prepared) and retain them for five years from the end of the relevant tax year. <Newly added Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 18, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ⑱ 영 별표 6 제2호사목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사전 취업계약 등”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 계약을 말한다. <신설 2020. 3. 13., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: 18. In Subparagraph 2(g) of Annex 6 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “prior employment contract, etc. prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to any of the contracts falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업수요 맞춤형 고등학교 등 재학생에 대한 고용을 목적으로 해당 학교와 체결하는 「직업교육훈련 촉진법」 제2조제5호나목에 따른 특약으로서 다음 각 목의 요건을 모두 갖춘 특약(이하 이 조에서 “산업체 맞춤형 직업교육훈련계약”이라 한다)
rows.text_en: 1. A special agreement pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5, Item B of the Vocational Education and Training Promotion Act, concluded with a school for the purpose of employing students enrolled in industry-demand-tailored high schools, etc., provided that it meets all of the requirements of each of the following items (hereinafter referred to as “industry-tailored vocational education and training contract” in this Article)

rows.source_ko: 가. 산업수요 맞춤형 고등학교 등에 교육부장관이 정하는 산업체 맞춤형 직업교육훈련과정을 설치할 것
rows.text_en: a. Establish industry-tailored vocational education and training courses as determined by the Minister of Education in high schools, etc. tailored to industrial demand.

rows.source_ko: 나. 해당 내국인의 생산시설 또는 근무장소에서 산업수요 맞춤형 고등학교 등 재학생에 대하여 교육부장관이 정하는 기간 이상의 현장훈련을 실시할 것
rows.text_en: b. Conduct on-the-job training for students enrolled in industry-demand-tailored high schools, etc., at the production facilities or workplace of the relevant resident for a period not shorter than the period determined by the Minister of Education.

rows.source_ko: 다. 산업체 맞춤형 직업교육훈련과정 이수자에 대한 고용요건 등이 포함될 것
rows.text_en: c. Include employment requirements, etc. for persons who have completed the industry-tailored vocational education and training course.

rows.source_ko: 라. 가목부터 다목까지의 요건 등에 관한 사항이 포함된 교육부장관이 정하는 계약서에 따라 산업체 맞춤형 직업교육훈련계약을 체결할 것
rows.text_en: d. Conclude an industry-tailored vocational education and training contract in accordance with a contract prescribed by the Minister of Education that includes matters concerning the requirements, etc. under items (a) through (c).

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업수요 맞춤형 고등학교 등 재학생에 대한 고용을 목적으로 해당 학교 및 「직업교육훈련 촉진법」 제2조제2호에 따른 직업교육훈련기관과 체결하는 같은 법 제2조제5호나목에 따른 특약으로서 다음 각 목의 요건을 모두 갖춘 특약(이하 이 조에서 “취업인턴 직업교육훈련계약”이라 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. A special agreement pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5, Item B of the Vocational Education and Training Promotion Act, concluded with the relevant school and a vocational education and training institution pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the same Act for the purpose of employing enrolled students of industry-demand-tailored high schools, etc., provided that it meets all of the requirements of each of the following items (hereinafter referred to as “Employment Internship Vocational Education and Training Contract” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 가. 산업수요 맞춤형 고등학교 등 또는 직업교육훈련기관에 교육부장관이 정하는 취업인턴 직업교육훈련과정을 설치할 것
rows.text_en: a. Establish employment internship vocational education and training courses designated by the Minister of Education at high schools tailored to industrial demand, etc., or vocational education and training institutions.

rows.source_ko: 나. 해당 내국인의 생산시설 또는 근무장소에서 산업수요 맞춤형 고등학교 등 재학생에 대하여 교육부장관이 정하는 기간 이상의 현장훈련을 실시할 것
rows.text_en: b. Conduct on-the-job training for students enrolled in industry-demand-tailored high schools, etc., at the production facilities or workplace of the relevant resident for a period not shorter than the period determined by the Minister of Education.

rows.source_ko: 다. 취업인턴 직업교육훈련과정 이수자에 대한 고용요건 등이 포함될 것
rows.text_en: c. Include employment requirements, etc. for persons who have completed the employment internship vocational education and training course.

rows.source_ko: 라. 가목부터 다목까지의 요건 등에 관한 사항이 포함된 교육부장관이 정하는 계약서에 따라 취업인턴 직업교육훈련계약을 체결할 것
rows.text_en: d. Conclude an employment internship vocational education and training contract in accordance with a contract prescribed by the Minister of Education that includes matters concerning the requirements, etc. under items (a) through (c).

rows.source_ko: ⑲ 영 별표 6 제2호아목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사전 취업약정 등”이란 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 갖춘 약정 등을 말한다. <신설 2021. 3. 16., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: (19) In subparagraph 2(h) of Annex 6 to the Enforcement Decree, the term “prior employment agreement, etc. prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to an agreement, etc. satisfying all the requirements of the following subparagraphs. <Newly Inserted Mar. 16, 2021; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대학교 등에 「산업교육진흥 및 산학연협력촉진에 관한 법률」 제11조의3에 따라 교육부장관이 정하는 표준화된 운영기준(이하 이 조에서 “표준운영기준”이라 한다)을 준수하는 현장실습 과정을 설치할 것
rows.text_en: 1. Establish field training courses at universities, etc., that comply with the standardized operational standards prescribed by the Minister of Education pursuant to Article 11-3 of the Act on the Promotion of Industrial Education and Industry-Academic-Research Cooperation (hereinafter referred to as “Standard Operational Standards” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 현장실습 산업체의 생산시설 또는 근무장소에서 대학교 재학생에 대하여 「산업교육진흥 및 산학연협력촉진에 관한 법률」 제11조의3에 따라 교육부장관이 정하는 기간 이상의 현장실습을 실시할 것
rows.text_en: 2. Conduct field training for university students at the production facilities or workplaces of industrial companies for a period equal to or longer than that determined by the Minister of Education pursuant to Article 11-3 of the Act on the Promotion of Industrial Education and Industry-Academic-Research Cooperation.

rows.source_ko: 3. 표준운영기준을 준수하는 현장실습의 이수자에 대한 고용조건 등이 포함될 것
rows.text_en: 3. Employment conditions, etc. for those who have completed field training in compliance with standard operating procedures shall be included.

rows.source_ko: ⑳ 영 별표 6 제1호가목3)에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 것”이란 제12조제3항제7호 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 소프트웨어를 말한다. <신설 2025. 3. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: (20) In Item 1, Subparagraph (a) 3) of Annex 6 of the Enforcement Decree , “as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to software falling under any of the subparagraphs of Item 7 of Article 12 , Paragraph 3. <Newly added Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ㉑ 영 별표 6 제2호차목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 것”이란 강의료, 교육훈련용 교재비, 실습재료비 및 교육용품비를 말한다. 다만, 수강료 등 교육훈련에 대한 대가를 받은 경우 그 금액은 제외한다. <신설 2025. 3. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: (21) In subparagraph 2(j) of Annex 6 to the Enforcement Decree, the term “matters prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to lecture fees, expenses for educational training materials, expenses for practical training materials, and expenses for educational supplies. Provided, That where consideration for educational training, such as tuition fees, has been received, the amount received shall be excluded. <Newly Inserted Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>
[Wholly Amended Mar. 30, 2007]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(현물출자의 범위) 영 제9조제10항 본문에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 현물출자”란 사업장별로 그 사업에 관한 권리(미수금에 관한 것을 제외한다)와 의무(미지급금에 관한 것을 제외한다)를 포괄적으로 출자하는 것을 말한다. <개정 2007. 11. 23., 2008. 4. 29., 2010. 4. 20., 2011. 4. 7., 2013. 2. 23., 2020. 3. 13., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Scope of Contribution in Kind) In the main text of Article 9, Paragraph 10 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “contribution in kind prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the comprehensive contribution of rights (excluding those relating to accounts receivable) and obligations (excluding those relating to accounts payable) relating to the business on a workplace-by-workplace basis. <Amended Nov. 23, 2007; Apr. 29, 2008; Apr. 20, 2010; Apr. 7, 2011; Feb. 23, 2013; Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2000.]
Article 7-3 Deleted <Mar. 21, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제8조
rows.text_en: Article 8
[Formerly Article 8 moved to Article 13 <Mar. 20, 2019>]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의2(기금운용법인 등의 범위) 영 제12조제2항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 법인”이란 「법인세법 시행규칙」 제56조의2제1항 및 제2항 각 호의 법인을 말한다. <개정 2014. 3. 14., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-2 (Scope of Fund Management Corporations, etc.) In Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “corporation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the corporations specified in each subparagraph of Article 56-2, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Corporate Tax Act. <Amended Mar. 14, 2014; Jan. 2, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 7, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의3(연구개발특구 등에의 입주기업 등에 대한 법인세 등의 감면 적용 시 사업용자산의 범위) 영 제11조의2제3항, 제61조제3항, 제99조의8제3항, 제116조의14제2항, 제116조의15제4항, 제116조의21제4항, 제116조의25제2항, 제116조의26제3항, 제116조의27제3항 및 제116조의36제3항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사업용자산”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자산을 말한다. <개정 2012. 2. 28., 2014. 3. 14., 2019. 3. 20., 2020. 3. 13., 2022. 3. 18., 2023. 3. 20., 2024. 3. 22., 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-3 (Scope of business assets for the application of reductions, etc., of corporate income tax for tenant companies in research and development special zones, etc.) In Article 11-2 , Paragraph 3 ; Article 61 , Paragraph 3 ; Article 99-8 , Paragraph 3 ; Article 116-14 , Paragraph 2; Article 116-15 , Paragraph 4; Article 116-21 , Paragraph 4 ; Article 116-25 , Paragraph 2; Article 116-26, Paragraph 3 ; Article 116-27 , Paragraph 3 ; and Article 116-36 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “business assets prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to any of the assets falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 14, 2014; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 20, 2023; Mar. 22, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026; Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 특구 등에 소재하거나 해당 특구 등에서 해당 사업에 주로 사용하는 사업용 유형자산
rows.text_en: 1. Tangible business assets located in the relevant special zone, etc., or primarily used for the relevant business within the relevant special zone, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 특구 등에 소재하거나 해당 특구 등에서 해당 사업에 주로 사용하기 위해 건설 중인 자산
rows.text_en: 2. Assets located in the relevant special zone, etc., or assets under construction in the relevant special zone, etc., for primary use in the relevant project

rows.source_ko: 3. 「법인세법 시행규칙」 별표 3에 따른 무형자산
rows.text_en: 3. Intangible assets pursuant to Annex 3 of the Enforcement Rules of the Corporate Tax Act
[This Article Newly Inserted April 7, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의4(벤처기업 주식매수선택권 조기행사 사유) 영 제14조의4제5항제3호에서 “사망, 정년 등 재정경제부령으로 정하는 불가피한 사유”란 주식매수선택권을 부여받은 법 제16조의4제1항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 벤처기업 임직원이 사망 또는 정년을 초과하거나 그 밖에 자신에게 책임 없는 사유로 퇴임 또는 퇴직한 경우를 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-4 (Reasons for Early Exercise of Stock Options by Venture Enterprises) In Article 14-4(5)3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “unavoidable reasons prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, such as death or reaching retirement age” refers to cases where an employee or executive of a venture enterprise who has been granted stock options pursuant to the part of Article 16-4(1) of the Act other than its subparagraphs dies, exceeds the retirement age, or retires or resigns for other reasons not attributable to the employee or executive. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>
[Wholly revised Mar. 20, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의5(기술혁신형 중소기업의 범위 등) ① 영 제11조의3제1항제4호사목 및 영 제11조의4제2항제4호사목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 인증 등”이란 영 제11조의3제1항제4호가목부터 바목까지 및 영 제11조의4제2항제4호가목부터 바목까지와 유사한 경우로서 재정경제부장관이 정하여 고시하는 인증 등을 말한다. <개정 2017. 3. 17., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-5 (Scope of Technology Innovation-Type Small and Medium Enterprises, etc.) ①In Article 11-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4, Item (g) of the Enforcement Decree and Article 11-4, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 , Item (g) of the Enforcement Decree, the term “certification, etc. prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to certification, etc. prescribed and notified by the Minister of Finance and Economy in cases similar to Article 11-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4, Items (a) through (f) of the Enforcement Decree and Article 11-4, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4, Items ( a ) through ( f ) of the Enforcement Decree . <Amended Mar. 17, 2017; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제11조의3제3항제1호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 기술비법 또는 기술”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기술비법 또는 기술로서 「산업기술혁신 촉진법」 제38조에 따른 한국산업기술진흥원에 등록되어 관리되는 기술비법 또는 기술을 말한다. <신설 2017. 3. 17., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: (2) In Article 11-3(3)1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “technical know-how or technology prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to technical know-how or technology falling under any of the following subparagraphs that is registered with and managed by the Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology pursuant to Article 38 of the Industrial Technology Innovation Promotion Act. <Newly Inserted Mar. 17, 2017; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 피합병법인 또는 피인수법인이 국내에서 자체 연구ㆍ개발한 과학기술분야에 속하는 기술비법(공업소유권, 「해외건설 촉진법」에 따른 해외건설 엔지니어링활동 또는 「엔지니어링산업 진흥법」에 따른 엔지니어링활동과 관련된 기술비법은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Technical know-how in the field of science and technology independently researched and developed in Korea by the surviving or acquiring corporation (excluding industrial property rights and technical know-how related to overseas construction engineering activities under the Overseas Construction Promotion Act or engineering activities under the Engineering Industry Promotion Act).

rows.source_ko: 2. 피합병법인 또는 피인수법인이 국내에서 자체 연구ㆍ개발한 「기술의 이전 및 사업화 촉진에 관한 법률」 제2조제1호에 따른 기술
rows.text_en: 2. Technology under Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the "Act on Promotion of Technology Transfer and Commercialization" independently researched and developed in Korea by the merged or acquired corporation

[This Article newly established Mar. 14, 2016]
[Title amended Mar. 17, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의6(산업재산권 출자주식 전용계좌 요건) ① 영 제14조의5제3항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 계좌”란 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 충족하는 계좌를 말한다. <개정 2017. 3. 17., 2019. 3. 20., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-6 (Requirements for Dedicated Accounts for Shares Contributing to Industrial Property Rights) ① The term “account prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” in Article 14-5, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree refers to an account that satisfies all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 17, 2017; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제14조의5제1항 각 호에 따른 권리(이하 이 조에서 “산업재산권”이라 한다)을 보유한 자가 본인의 명의로 개설할 것
rows.text_en: 1. A person holding any of the rights referred to in the subparagraphs of Article 14-5(1) of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “industrial property rights” in this Article) shall open an account in his or her own name.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「자본시장과 금융투자업에 관한 법률」 제8조제1항에 따른 금융투자업자가 산업재산권을 보유한 자의 다른 매매거래계좌와 구분하여 산업재산권 출자주식 전용계좌의 명칭으로 별도로 개설ㆍ관리할 것
rows.text_en: 2. A financial investment business operator pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Capital Market and Financial Investment Business Act shall separately open and manage an account under the name of an account dedicated to shares contributed to industrial property rights, distinguishing it from other trading accounts of the holder of industrial property rights.

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업재산권을 영 제14조제3항에 따른 벤처기업등(이하 이 호에서 “벤처기업등”이라 한다)에 출자하고 취득한 벤처기업등의 주식만을 거래할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Trade only the shares of venture companies, etc. acquired by contributing industrial property rights to venture companies, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “venture companies, etc.” in this subparagraph) pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree .

rows.source_ko: 4. 계좌 개설 이후 1개월 내 주식이 입고되지 아니할 경우에는 해당 계좌를 폐쇄하는 내용으로 사전에 약정할 것
rows.text_en: 4. Agree in advance that the account will be closed if stocks are not deposited within one month of opening.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 14, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의7(기술비법의 범위 등) 영 제11조제3항제2호 및 제3호에서 “수입금액 기준 등 재정경제부령으로 정하는 요건을 충족하는 것”이란 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 충족하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-7 (Scope of Technical Know-How, etc.) In Article 11(3)2 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the phrase “satisfying the requirements prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, such as revenue amount standards” refers to cases satisfying all of the requirements of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 기업이나 해당 기업이 「중소기업기본법 시행령」 제2조제3호에 따른 관계기업에 속하는 경우 해당 관계기업의 직전 5개 과세연도의 매출액(매출액은 영 제2조제4항에 따른 계산방법으로 산출하며, 과세연도가 1년 미만인 과세연도의 매출액은 1년으로 환산한 매출액을 말한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)의 평균금액이 500억원 이하일 것
rows.text_en: 1. The average amount of sales revenue for the five preceding tax years of the relevant enterprise, or in cases where the relevant enterprise belongs to a related enterprise pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises, shall be 50 billion won or less (sales revenue shall be calculated using the method prescribed in Article 2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, and sales revenue for tax years of less than one year shall refer to sales revenue converted to one year; hereinafter the same applies in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 기업이 영 제11조제3항 각 호에 해당하는 것을 거래하여 얻은 직전 5개 과세연도의 매출액의 평균금액이 70억원 이하일 것
rows.text_en: 2. The average amount of sales revenue over the five immediately preceding tax years obtained by the company from transactions falling under each subparagraph of Article 11, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be 7 billion won or less .
3. Deleted <March 18, 2022>
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 17, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의8(소재ㆍ부품ㆍ장비의 범위) 영 제12조의3제7항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 소재ㆍ부품ㆍ장비 품목”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 품목을 말한다. <개정 2024. 1. 5., 2025. 3. 21., 2025. 10. 31., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-8 (Scope of Materials, Parts, and Equipment) In Article 12-3, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “materials, parts, and equipment items prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to any of the items falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 5, 2024; Mar. 21, 2025; Oct. 31, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「소재ㆍ부품ㆍ장비산업 경쟁력 강화 및 공급망 안정화를 위한 특별조치법」 제12조에 따른 핵심전략기술과 관련된 품목으로서 산업통상부장관이 재정경제부장관과 협의하여 고시하는 품목
rows.text_en: 1. Items related to core strategic technologies pursuant to Article 12 of the "Special Measures Act for Strengthening the Competitiveness of the Materials, Parts, and Equipment Industry and Stabilizing the Supply Chain," which are designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy in consultation with the Minister of Finance and Economy.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 지원 기본법」 제13조에 따른 경제안보품목(「소재ㆍ부품ㆍ장비산업 경쟁력 강화 및 공급망 안정화를 위한 특별조치법 시행규칙」 별표 1에 따른 소재ㆍ부품 및 장비로 한정한다) 중 재정경제부장관이 산업통상부장관 및 경제안보품목을 지정한 관계 중앙행정기관의 장과 협의하여 정하는 품목
rows.text_en: 2. Among the economic security items pursuant to Article 13 of the Framework Act on Support for Supply Chain Stabilization for Economic Security (limited to materials, parts, and equipment pursuant to Annex 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Special Measures Act on Strengthening Competitiveness of the Materials, Parts, and Equipment Industry and Stabilizing Supply Chains), items determined by the Minister of Finance and Economy in consultation with the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy and the heads of relevant central administrative agencies that have designated economic security items.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 13, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(외국인기술자에 대한 소득세면제등) ①영 제16조제1항제1호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 엔지니어링기술도입계약”이란 「엔지니어링산업 진흥법」 제2조제5호에 따른 엔지니어링기술의 도입계약(계약금액이 30만달러 이상인 도입계약으로 한정한다)을 말한다. <개정 2005. 3. 11., 2008. 4. 29., 2012. 2. 28., 2015. 3. 13., 2019. 3. 20., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Exemption from Income Tax, etc. for Foreign Technicians) ①In Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “engineering technology introduction contract prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to an engineering technology introduction contract pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Engineering Industry Promotion Act (limited to introduction contracts with a contract amount of 300,000 USD or more). <Amended Mar. 11, 2005; Apr. 29, 2008; Feb. 28, 2012; Mar. 13, 2015; Mar. 20, 2019; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제16조제1항제2호가목을 적용할 때 자연계ㆍ이공계ㆍ의학계 분야의 예시는 별표 1의2와 같다. <개정 2021. 3. 16.>
rows.text_en: ② When applying Subparagraph 2, Item (a) of Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, examples of natural science, science and engineering, and medical fields are as set forth in Table 1-2 . <Amended Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제16조제1항제2호나목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 국외의 대학 및 연구기관 등”이란 외국의 대학과 그 부설연구소, 국책연구기관 및 기업부설연구소(이하 이 조에서 “국외연구기관등”이라 한다)를 말한다. <신설 2021. 3. 16., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item ( b) of the Enforcement Decree, the term “overseas universities and research institutions, etc. prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to foreign universities and their affiliated research institutes, state-funded research institutes, and corporate research institutes (hereinafter referred to as “overseas research institutions, etc.” in this Article). <Newly added Mar. 16, 2021; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제16조제1항제2호나목을 적용할 때 국외연구기관등에서 연구원(행정 사무만을 담당하는 사람은 제외한다)으로 근무한 기간이 합산하여 같은 목에 따른 기간(학위 취득 기간 및 휴직 등으로 인해 실제로 연구원으로 근무하지 않은 기간을 제외한다) 이상인 경우에는 연구개발 및 기술개발 경험이 있는 것으로 본다. <신설 2021. 3. 16.>
rows.text_en: ④ When applying Subparagraph 2, Item (b) of Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , if the cumulative period of service as a researcher (excluding those responsible solely for administrative duties) at an overseas research institution, etc., is equal to or greater than the period stipulated in the same item (excluding periods during which the individual did not actually work as a researcher due to degree acquisition, leave of absence, etc.), the individual shall be deemed to have experience in research and development and technology development. <Newly added Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제16조제1항제2호의 요건에 해당하여 영 제16조제3항에 따른 세액감면신청서를 제출하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 함께 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 3. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In cases where an application for tax reduction or exemption pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is submitted in accordance with the requirements of Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the following documents must be submitted together. <Amended Mar. 21, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 학위증명서
rows.text_en: 1. Degree Certificate

rows.source_ko: 2. 국외의 대학 및 연구기관 등에서 5년(박사 학위 소지자의 경우 2년) 이상 연구개발 및 기술개발 경험이 있음을 증명할 수 있는 서류로서 다음 각 목의 내용이 포함된 증명서
rows.text_en: 2. A certificate containing the details of each of the following items, as a document proving at least 5 years (2 years for holders of a doctoral degree) of experience in research and development and technology development at overseas universities and research institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 가. 감면신청자의 이름
rows.text_en: a. Name of the applicant for reduction

rows.source_ko: 나. 국외연구기관등의 명칭 및 주소
rows.text_en: B. Name and address of overseas research institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 다. 국외연구기관등에서 근무한 기간, 근무부서, 연구분야 및 해당 부서 책임자의 확인
rows.text_en: C. Confirmation of the period of employment, department, research field, and head of the relevant department at overseas research institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 「기초연구진흥 및 기술개발지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 별지 제5호서식의 기업부설연구소 인정서, 같은 규칙 별지 제7호서식의 연구개발전담부서 인정서 및 그 밖에 영 제16조의3제2항 각 호의 기관 또는 부서에서 근무하고 있음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Certificate of Recognition for a Corporate Research Institute (Form No. 5 of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Promotion of Basic Research and Support for Technology Development) , Certificate of Recognition for a Dedicated Research and Development Department (Form No. 7 of the same Rules), and other documents proving employment at an institution or department listed in each subparagraph of Article 16-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제16조제1항제3호의 요건에 해당하여 영 제16조제3항에 따른 세액감면신청서를 제출하는 경우에는 「첨단산업 인재혁신 특별법」 제28조제1항에 따른 우수 해외인재임을 확인하는 서류로서 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시하는 서류를 제출해야 한다. <신설 2025. 3. 21., 2025. 10. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ In cases where an application for tax reduction under Article 16, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is submitted in accordance with the requirements of Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , documents confirming that the applicant is an outstanding overseas talent pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on Human Resource Innovation in Advanced Industries, as prescribed and notified by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, must be submitted. <Newly added Mar. 21, 2025; Oct. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(내국인 우수 인력의 국내복귀에 대한 소득세 감면) ① 영 제16조의3제1항제1호를 적용할 때 자연계ㆍ이공계ㆍ의학계 분야의 예시는 별표 1의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Income Tax Reduction for the Return of Excellent Domestic Personnel) ①Examples of natural science, science and engineering, and medical fields when applying Article 16-3, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in Table 1-2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제16조의3제1항제3호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 국외의 대학 및 연구기관 등”이란 외국의 대학과 그 부설연구소, 국책연구기관 및 기업부설연구소(이하 이 조에서 “국외연구기관등”이라 한다)를 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 16-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “overseas universities and research institutions, etc. prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to foreign universities and their affiliated research institutes, state-funded research institutes, and corporate research institutes (hereinafter referred to as “overseas research institutions, etc.” in this Article). <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제16조의3제1항제3호를 적용할 때 국외연구기관등에서 연구원(행정 사무만을 담당하는 사람은 제외한다)으로 근무한 기간이 합산하여 5년(휴직 등으로 인해 실제로 연구원으로 근무하지 않은 기간을 제외한다) 이상인 경우에는 연구개발 및 기술개발 경험이 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ When applying Article 16-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, if the cumulative period of service as a researcher (excluding those in charge of administrative affairs only) at an overseas research institution, etc. is 5 years or more (excluding periods during which the person did not actually work as a researcher due to leave of absence, etc.), the person shall be deemed to have experience in research and development and technology development.

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제16조의3제3항에 따른 세액감면신청서를 제출하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 함께 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 3. 21.>
rows.text_en: ④ When submitting an application for tax reduction pursuant to Article 16-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the following documents must be submitted together. <Amended Mar. 21, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 박사학위증명서
rows.text_en: 1. Doctoral Degree Certificate

rows.source_ko: 2. 「재외국민등록법」 제7조에 따른 재외국민등록부 등본 등 국외에서 5년 이상 거주하였음을 증명할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving residence abroad for five years or more, such as a certified copy of the Register of Overseas Koreans pursuant to Article 7 of the Overseas Koreans Registration Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 국외의 대학 및 연구기관 등에서 5년 이상 연구개발 및 기술개발 경험이 있음을 증명할 수 있는 서류로서 다음 각 목의 내용이 포함된 증명서
rows.text_en: 3. A certificate containing the details of each of the following items, as a document proving at least 5 years of experience in research and development and technology development at overseas universities and research institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 가. 감면신청자의 이름
rows.text_en: a. Name of the applicant for reduction

rows.source_ko: 나. 국외연구기관등의 명칭 및 주소
rows.text_en: b. Name and address of overseas research institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 다. 국외연구기관등에서 근무한 기간, 근무부서, 연구분야 및 해당 부서 책임자의 확인
rows.text_en: c. Confirmation of the period of service, department, research field, and head of the relevant department at overseas research institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 「기초연구진흥 및 기술개발지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 별지 제5호서식의 기업부설연구소 인정서, 같은 규칙 별지 제7호서식의 연구개발전담부서 인정서 및 그 밖에 영 제16조의3제2항 각 호의 기관 또는 부서에서 근무하고 있음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Certificate of Recognition for a Corporate Research Institute (Form No. 5 of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Promotion of Basic Research and Support for Technology Development) , Certificate of Recognition for a Dedicated Research and Development Department (Form No. 7 of the same Rules), and other documents proving employment at an institution or department listed in each subparagraph of Article 16-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 13, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(외화증권의 범위) ①영 제18조제4항제1호에서 “재정경제부령이 정하는 것”이란 외국환거래에 관하여 재정경제부장관이 정하는 기준에 따라 발행된 외화증권을 말한다. <개정 2000. 3. 30., 2008. 4. 29., 2010. 4. 20., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Scope of Foreign Currency Securities) (1) In Article 18(4)1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to foreign currency securities issued in accordance with the standards prescribed by the Minister of Finance and Economy concerning foreign exchange transactions. <Amended Mar. 30, 2000; Apr. 29, 2008; Apr. 20, 2010; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제18조제4항제2호에서 “재정경제부령이 정하는 외국의 유가증권시장”이란 「자본시장과 금융투자업에 관한 법률」에 따른 유가증권시장 또는 코스닥시장과 기능이 유사한 외국의 유가증권시장을 말한다. <신설 2000. 3. 30., 2002. 3. 30., 2005. 3. 11., 2008. 4. 29., 2009. 4. 7., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 18, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “foreign securities market prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a foreign securities market that is functionally similar to a securities market or KOSDAQ market under the Capital Markets and Financial Investment Business Act . <Newly added Mar. 30, 2000; Mar. 30, 2002; Mar. 11, 2005; Apr. 29, 2008; Apr. 7, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(사업용자산의 범위 등) ① 영 제21조제2항에서 “건축물 등 재정경제부령으로 정하는 자산”이란 별표 1의 건축물 등 사업용 유형자산을 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Scope of Business Assets, etc.) ① In Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “assets prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, such as buildings”refers to tangible business assets, such as buildings, set forth in Annex 1. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제21조제3항제1호에서 “사업용자산으로서 재정경제부령으로 정하는 자산”이란 다음 각 호에 해당하는 시설을 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 21, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “business assets prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to facilities falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026; Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 연구ㆍ시험 및 직업훈련시설: 제13조의11제1항 및 제2항에 따른 시설
rows.text_en: 1. Research, testing, and vocational training facilities: Facilities pursuant to Article 13-11, Paragraphs 1 and 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 에너지절약 시설: 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 시설
rows.text_en: 2. Energy-saving facilities: Facilities falling under any of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 「에너지이용 합리화법」 제14조제1항에 따른 에너지절약형 시설투자(에너지절약전문기업이 대가를 분할상환 받은 후 소유권을 이전하는 조건으로 같은 법 제25조에 따라 설치한 경우를 포함한다) 및 에너지절약형 기자재
rows.text_en: a. Investment in energy-saving facilities pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Energy Rationalization Act (including cases where an energy-saving specialized enterprise installs equipment pursuant to Article 25 of the same Act on the condition that ownership is transferred after receiving repayment in installments ) and energy-saving equipment

rows.source_ko: 나. 「물의 재이용 촉진 및 지원에 관한 법률」 제2조제4호에 따른 중수도
rows.text_en: b. Graywater under Article 2(4) of the Act on the Promotion and Support of Water Reuse.

rows.source_ko: 3. 환경보전 시설: 별표 2에 따른 환경보전시설
rows.text_en: 3. Environmental conservation facilities: Environmental conservation facilities pursuant to Annex 2

rows.source_ko: 4. 근로자복지 증진 시설: 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 시설
rows.text_en: 4. Facilities for the Promotion of Worker Welfare: Facilities falling under any of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 무주택 종업원(출자자인 임원은 제외한다)에게 임대하기 위한 「주택법」에 따른 국민주택 규모의 주택
rows.text_en: a. Housing of national housing size under the Housing Act for the purpose of leasing to employees without housing (excluding executives who are shareholders)

rows.source_ko: 나. 종업원용 기숙사
rows.text_en: b. Employee dormitories.

rows.source_ko: 다. 장애인ㆍ노인ㆍ임산부 등의 편의 증진을 위한 시설 또는 장애인을 고용하기 위한 시설로서 별표 3에 따른 시설
rows.text_en: c. Facilities for promoting the convenience of persons with disabilities, older persons, pregnant women, etc., or facilities for employing persons with disabilities, as prescribed in Annex 3.

rows.source_ko: 라. 종업원용 휴게실, 체력단련실, 샤워시설 또는 목욕시설(건물 등의 구조를 변경하여 해당시설을 취득하는 경우를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: d. Employee lounges, fitness rooms, shower facilities, or bathing facilities (including cases where such facilities are acquired by altering the structure of a building, etc.).

rows.source_ko: 마. 종업원의 건강관리를 위해 「의료법」 제35조에 따라 개설한 부속 의료기관
rows.text_en: e. An affiliated medical institution established pursuant to Article 35 of the Medical Service Act for the health management of employees.

rows.source_ko: 바. 「영유아보육법」 제10조제4호에 따른 직장어린이집
rows.text_en: f. Workplace childcare center pursuant to Article 10, Subparagraph 4 of the Infant and Toddler Care Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 안전시설: 별표 4에 따른 안전시설
rows.text_en: 5. Safety facilities: Safety facilities in accordance with Annex 4

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제21조제3항제2호에서 “운수업을 경영하는 자가 사업에 직접 사용하는 차량 및 운반구 등 재정경제부령으로 정하는 자산”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 사업에 직접 사용하는 각 호의 시설을 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 21, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “assets prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, such as vehicles and transportation equipment directly used in the business by a person operating a transportation business” refers to the facilities listed in each of the following subparagraphs that are directly used in the business according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 운수업을 주된 사업으로 하는 중소기업(영 제2조제1항에 따른 중소기업을 말한다. 이하 이 조에서 “중소기업”이라 한다): 차량 및 운반구(「개별소비세법」 제1조제2항제3호에 따른 자동차로서 자가용인 것을 제외한다)와 선박
rows.text_en: 1. Small and medium-sized enterprises whose main business is transportation ( referring to small and medium-sized enterprises pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree; hereinafter referred to as “small and medium-sized enterprises” in this Article): Vehicles and transportation equipment ( excluding privately owned automobiles pursuant to Article 1, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Individual Consumption Tax Act ) and vessels

rows.source_ko: 2. 어업을 주된 사업으로 하는 중소기업: 선박
rows.text_en: 2. Small and medium-sized enterprises primarily engaged in fisheries: Ships

rows.source_ko: 3. 건설업: 「지방세법 시행규칙」 제3조에 따른 기계장비
rows.text_en: 3. Construction business: Machinery and equipment pursuant to Article 3 of the Enforcement Rules of the Local Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 도매업ㆍ소매업ㆍ물류산업: 별표 5에 따른 유통산업합리화시설
rows.text_en: 4. Wholesale, retail, and logistics industries: Distribution industry rationalization facilities pursuant to Annex 5

rows.source_ko: 5. 「관광진흥법」에 따라 등록한 관광숙박업 및 국제회의기획업: 건축물과 해당 건축물에 딸린 시설물 중 「지방세법 시행령」 제6조에 따른 시설물
rows.text_en: 5. Tourism accommodation business and international conference planning business registered under the Tourism Promotion Act : Buildings and facilities attached to said buildings, among which facilities pursuant to Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Local Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 「관광진흥법」에 따라 등록한 전문휴양업 또는 종합휴양업: 「관광진흥법 시행령」 제2조제1항제3호가목 및 제5호가목에 따른 숙박시설, 전문휴양시설(골프장 시설은 제외한다) 및 종합유원시설업의 시설
rows.text_en: 6. Specialized resort businesses or comprehensive resort businesses registered under the Tourism Promotion Act : Accommodation facilities, specialized resort facilities (excluding golf course facilities), and facilities of comprehensive amusement park businesses pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 3 , Item (a ) and Subparagraph 5 , Item (a) of the Enforcement Decree of the Tourism Promotion Act.

rows.source_ko: 7. 중소기업이 해당 업종의 사업에 직접 사용하는 소프트웨어: 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 것을 제외한 소프트웨어
rows.text_en: 7. Software directly used by small and medium-sized enterprises in the business of the relevant industry: Software excluding any of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 인사, 급여, 회계 및 재무 등 지원업무에 사용하는 소프트웨어
rows.text_en: a. Software used for support functions such as HR, payroll, accounting, and finance

rows.source_ko: 나. 문서, 도표 및 발표용 자료 작성 등 일반 사무에 사용하는 소프트웨어
rows.text_en: b. Software used for general office work, such as preparing documents, charts, and presentation materials.

rows.source_ko: 다. 컴퓨터 등의 구동을 위한 기본운영체제(Operating System) 소프트웨어
rows.text_en: c. Basic operating system software for operating computers, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 16, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(신성장ㆍ원천기술의 사업화를 위한 시설의 범위 등) ① 영 제21조제4항제1호가목1)에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 시설”이란 별표 6에 따른 시설을 말한다. <개정 2025. 6. 30., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Scope of Facilities, etc. for Commercialization of New Growth and Source Technologies) ① In Article 21, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 1, Item ( a) 1) of the Enforcement Decree, the term “facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy”refers to facilities set forth in Annex 6. <Amended June 30, 2025; Jan 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제21조제4항제2호가목1)에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 시설”이란 별표 6의2 제1호부터 제7호까지의 시설을 말한다. <개정 2025. 6. 30., 2025. 11. 28., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 21, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 2, Item (a) 1) of the Enforcement Decree, the term “facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the facilities listed in Subparagraphs 1 through 7 of Annex 6-2 . <Amended June 30, 2025; November 28, 2025; January 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제21조제4항제2호가목2)에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 시설”이란 별표 6의2 제8호의 시설을 말한다. <신설 2025. 11. 28., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 21, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 2, Item (a) 2) of the Enforcement Decree, “facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the facilities listed in Item 8 of Annex 6-2 . <Newly added Nov. 28, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제21조제10항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사유”란 해당 시설의 투자완료일부터 투자완료일이 속하는 과세연도의 다음 3개 과세연도의 종료일까지의 기간 중 화재 등으로 해당 시설이 파손되어 가동이 불가능한 경우를 말한다. <개정 2025. 11. 28., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ In the proviso to the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 21, Paragraph 10 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “reasons prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to cases where operation becomes impossible due to damage to the relevant facility caused by fire, etc., during the period from the date of completion of investment in the facility to the end of the three tax years following the tax year in which the investment completion date falls. <Amended Nov. 28, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제21조제14항에 따라 같은 조 제4항제1호가목1)에 따른 신성장사업화시설(이하 “신성장사업화시설”이라 한다) 또는 같은 항 제2호가목에 따른 국가전략기술사업화시설(이하 “국가전략기술사업화시설”이라 한다) 중 해당 기술을 사용하여 생산하는 제품 외에 다른 제품의 생산에도 사용되는 시설에 대하여 법 제24조제1항에 따른 세액공제를 적용받으려는 자는 다음 각 호에서 정하는 바에 따라 생산량을 측정ㆍ기록하고 제2호의 측정 기간 종료일부터 5년 동안 보관해야 한다. <개정 2025. 6. 30., 2025. 11. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 14 of the Enforcement Decree, any person who intends to apply for a tax credit under Article 24 , Paragraph 1 of the Act with respect to a facility for the commercialization of new growth businesses (hereinafter referred to as “New Growth Commercialization Facility”) under Article 21, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 1, Item (a) 1) of the same Article, or a facility for the commercialization of national strategic technologies (hereinafter referred to as “National Strategic Technology Commercialization Facility”) under Subparagraph 2, Item (a) of the same Paragraph, which is also used for the production of products other than those produced using the relevant technology, shall measure and record the production volume in accordance with the provisions of each of the following subparagraphs and retain it for five years from the end of the measurement period specified in Subparagraph 2. <Amended June 30, 2025; November 28, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 시설을 거쳐 저장ㆍ판매가 가능한 형태로 생산된 제품 또는 반제품(그 제품 또는 반제품을 사용하여 생산한 다른 제품 또는 반제품은 제외한다)을 측정 대상으로 할 것
rows.text_en: 1. The measurement target shall be products or semi-products produced in a form suitable for storage or sale through the relevant facility (excluding other products or semi-products produced using said products or semi-products).

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 시설의 투자완료일(투자완료일이 2022년 4월 1일 이전인 경우에는 2022년 4월 1일)부터 그 날이 속하는 과세연도의 다음 3개 과세연도의 종료일까지 측정할 것
rows.text_en: 2. It shall be measured from the investment completion date of the relevant facility (or April 1, 2022, if the investment completion date is prior to April 1, 2022) until the end of the three tax years following the tax year in which that date falls.

rows.source_ko: 3. 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 단위로 측정할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Measure in units according to the classifications in each of the following items.

rows.source_ko: 가. 고체류: 개수
rows.text_en: a. Solids: Number

rows.source_ko: 나. 액체류 및 기체류: 부피 단위 또는 해당 제품을 담은 동일한 부피의 용기 등의 개수
rows.text_en: b. Liquids and gases: volume units or the number of containers, etc., of the same volume containing the relevant product.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제21조제16항에 따라 같은 조 제4항제1호나목에 따른 신성장연구개발시설(이하 “신성장연구개발시설”이라 한다) 또는 같은 항 제2호나목에 따른 국가전략기술연구개발시설(이하 “국가전략기술연구개발시설”이라 한다) 중 해당 기술 외에 다른 기술의 연구개발에도 사용되는 시설 또는 일시적으로 사업화를 위해 사용되는 시설에 대하여 법 제24조제1항에 따른 세액공제를 적용받으려는 자는 다음 각 호에서 정하는 바에 따라 해당 시설의 연구개발업무 사용시간(일시적으로 사업화를 위해 사용된 시간을 포함하며, 이하 이 항에서 같다)을 측정ㆍ기록하고 제2호의 측정 기간 종료일부터 5년 동안 보관해야 한다. <신설 2025. 6. 30., 2025. 11. 28., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: (6) Pursuant to Article 21(16) of the Enforcement Decree, any person who intends to claim a tax credit under Article 24(1) of the Act for a facility used for research and development of technologies other than the relevant technology, or for a facility temporarily used for commercialization, among New Growth R&D Facilities under Article 21(4)1(b) or National Strategic Technology R&D Facilities under Article 21(4)2(b), shall measure and record the time the relevant facility is used for R&D activities (including time temporarily used for commercialization; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph) in accordance with the following subparagraphs, and retain the records for five years from the end of the measurement period specified in subparagraph 2. <Newly Inserted Jun. 30, 2025; Nov. 28, 2025; Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 사용시간을 분 단위로 측정하여 기록할 것
rows.text_en: 1. Measure and record the usage time in minutes according to the classifications in each of the following items.

rows.source_ko: 가. 해당 시설을 국가전략기술의 연구개발업무에 사용한 시간
rows.text_en: a. Time spent using the facility for research and development of national strategic technologies

rows.source_ko: 나. 해당 시설을 신성장ㆍ원천기술의 연구개발업무에 사용한 시간. 이 경우 해당 시설을 국가전략기술의 연구개발업무 및 신성장ㆍ원천기술의 연구개발업무에 동시에 사용한 시간은 신성장ㆍ원천기술의 연구개발업무에 사용한 시간으로 본다.
rows.text_en: b. Time spent using the relevant facility for R&D on new growth and source technologies. In this case, time spent using the facility simultaneously for R&D on national strategic technologies and R&D on new growth and source technologies shall be deemed time spent using the facility for R&D on new growth and source technologies.

rows.source_ko: 다. 해당 시설을 가목 및 나목 외의 업무에 사용한 시간
rows.text_en: c. Time spent using the relevant facility for tasks other than those specified in items a and b

rows.text_en: ⑦ Pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 17 of the Enforcement Decree, any person who intends to apply for a tax credit under Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Act for a National Strategic Technology Commercialization Facility that is also used to provide services other than those provided using National Strategic Technology shall measure and record the service provision hours of the said facility in accordance with the provisions of each of the following subparagraphs and retain them for five years from the end of the measurement period specified in subparagraph 2. <Newly added Nov. 28, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 사용시간을 분 단위로 측정하여 기록할 것

rows.text_en: a. Service provision time using the relevant facility's national strategic technology

rows.text_en: b. Service provision time, out of the total service provision time of the relevant facility, for services other than those specified in item (a).

rows.source_ko: 제12조의3(사후관리 대상 건물 또는 구축물의 범위) 영 제21조제5항제1호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 건축물 또는 구축물”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 시설을 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 12-3 (Scope of Buildings or Structures Subject to Post-Management) In Article 21, Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “buildings or structures prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to facilities falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(신성장사업화시설 또는 국가전략기술사업화시설의 인정 신청) ① 영 제21조제13항 후단에 따라 세액공제를 신청하는 자는 투자완료일이 속하는 달의 말일부터 3개월 이내에 재정경제부장관과 산업통상부장관에게 신성장사업화시설, 국가전략기술사업화시설, 신성장연구개발시설 또는 국가전략기술연구개발시설의 인정을 신청해야 한다. 다만, 동일한 과세연도에 완료된 둘 이상의 투자에 대하여 각각 영 제21조제13항 후단에 따라 세액공제를 신청하는 경우에는 가장 늦게 완료된 투자의 투자완료일이 속하는 달의 말일부터 3개월 이내에 인정을 신청할 수 있다. <개정 2025. 6. 30., 2025. 10. 31., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Application for Recognition of New Growth Commercialization Facility or National Strategic Technology Commercialization Facility) ① Any person applying for a tax credit pursuant to the latter part of Article 21, Paragraph 13 of the Enforcement Decree shall apply to the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy for recognition of a New Growth Commercialization Facility, a National Strategic Technology Commercialization Facility, a New Growth R&D Facility, or a National Strategic Technology R&D Facility within three months from the last day of the month in which the investment is completed. However, in cases where a tax credit is applied for each of two or more investments completed in the same tax year pursuant to the latter part of Article 21, Paragraph 13 of the Enforcement Decree, the application for recognition may be made within three months from the last day of the month in which the investment completed most recently falls. <Amended June 30, 2025; October 31, 2025; January 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 투자가 2개 이상의 과세연도에 걸쳐 이루어지는 경우로서 그 투자가 이루어지는 과세연도(투자완료일이 속하는 과세연도는 제외한다)에 투자한 금액에 대하여 영 제21조제13항 후단에 따라 세액공제를 신청하는 경우에는 해당 과세연도 종료일부터 3개월 이내에 제1항에 따른 인정을 신청해야 한다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 해당 과세연도의 다음 과세연도 종료일(다음 과세연도가 투자완료일이 속하는 과세연도인 경우에는 투자완료일이 속하는 달의 말일)부터 3개월 이내에 인정을 신청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, in cases where an investment spans two or more tax years and a tax credit is applied for in accordance with the latter part of Paragraph 13 of Article 21 of the Enforcement Decree regarding an amount invested in the tax year in which the investment is made (excluding the tax year in which the investment completion date falls) , an application for recognition under Paragraph 1 must be made within three months from the end of the relevant tax year. However, in any of the following cases, an application for recognition may be made within three months from the end of the tax year following the relevant tax year (or the last day of the month in which the investment completion date falls if the next tax year is the tax year in which the investment completion date falls).

rows.source_ko: 1. 투자개시일이 속하는 과세연도의 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of the tax year in which the investment commencement date falls

rows.source_ko: 2. 직전 과세연도에 투자한 금액에 대하여 신성장사업화시설 또는 국가전략기술사업화시설의 인정을 받은 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where the amount invested in the immediately preceding tax year has been recognized as a New Growth Commercialization Facility or a National Strategic Technology Commercialization Facility

rows.source_ko: 제13조의9(영상콘텐츠 제작비용에 대한 세액공제) ① 영 제22조의10제1항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 요건을 갖춘 자”란 같은 조 제2항 각 호에 따른 영상콘텐츠(이하 이 조에서 “영상콘텐츠”라 한다)의 실질적인 제작을 담당하는 자로서 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 요건을 갖춘 자를 말한다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2023. 3. 20., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-9 (Tax Credit for Production Costs of Video Content) ① In Article 22-10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “person meeting the requirements prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a person who is responsible for the substantial production of video content pursuant to each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 of the same Article (hereinafter referred to as “video content” in this Article) and who meets the requirements according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 20, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제22조의10제2항제1호 또는 제3호에 따른 영상콘텐츠를 제작하는 자의 경우: 다음 각 목의 요건 중 3개 이상의 요건을 갖출 것
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of a person producing video content pursuant to Article 22-10, Paragraph 2 , Subparagraph 1 or 3 of the Enforcement Decree : Must satisfy at least three of the requirements of each of the following items.

rows.source_ko: 가. 작가(극본, 시나리오 등을 집필하는 자를 말한다)와의 계약 체결을 담당할 것
rows.text_en: a. Responsible for concluding contracts with writers (referring to those who write screenplays, scenarios, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 나. 주요 출연자와의 계약 체결을 담당할 것
rows.text_en: b. Be responsible for concluding contracts with major cast members.

rows.source_ko: 다. 주요 스태프(연출, 촬영, 편집, 조명 또는 미술 스태프) 중 2가지 이상 분야의 책임자와의 계약 체결을 담당할 것
rows.text_en: c. Be responsible for concluding contracts with heads of at least two fields among the key staff (directing, cinematography, editing, lighting, or art staff).

rows.source_ko: 라. 제작비의 집행 및 관리와 관련된 모든 의사 결정을 담당할 것
rows.text_en: d. Be responsible for all decision-making related to the execution and management of production costs.

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제22조의10제2항제2호에 따른 영상콘텐츠를 제작하는 자의 경우: 「영화 및 비디오물의 진흥에 관한 법률」 제2조제9호가목에 따른 영화제작업자로서 제1호 각 목의 요건 중 3개 이상의 요건을 갖출 것
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of a person producing video content pursuant to Article 22-10, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree : As a film producer pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 9, Item ( a) of the Act on the Promotion of Film and Video, meet at least three of the requirements of each item of Subparagraph 1.
② Deleted <March 13, 2020>
③ Deleted <March 13, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제22조의10제2항제2호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 바에 따라 영화상영관에서 일정기간 이상 연속하여 상영된 것”이란 영화상영관에서 7일 이상 연속하여 상영된 것을 말한다. 다만, 「영화 및 비디오물의 진흥에 관한 법률」 제4조에 따른 영화진흥위원회가 예술영화 및 독립영화로 인정하는 경우에는 1일 이상 상영된 것을 말한다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ In Article 22-10, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the phrase “that which has been screened continuously for a certain period or longer in a movie theater as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a film screened continuously for 7 days or more in a movie theater. However, in cases where the Korean Film Council, pursuant to Article 4 of the Act on the Promotion of Film and Video, recognizes a film as an art film or independent film, it refers to a film screened for 1 day or more. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에 따른 상영 기간의 확인은 「영화 및 비디오물의 진흥에 관한 법률」 제39조에 따른 영화상영관입장권 통합전산망으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Confirmation of the screening period pursuant to Paragraph 4 shall be made through the integrated computerized ticketing system for movie theaters pursuant to Article 39 of the Act on the Promotion of Films and Video Materials .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제22조의10제3항 각 호 외의 부분 본문에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 비용”이란 별표 8의9에 따른 영상콘텐츠 제작비용을 말한다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ In the main text of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 22-10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “costs prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the video content production costs pursuant to Annex 8-9 . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 영 제22조의10제3항제2호에서 “광고 또는 홍보비용 등 재정경제부령으로 정하는 비용”이란 다음 각 호의 하나에 해당하는 비용을 말한다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2022. 3. 18., 2023. 3. 20., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ In Article 22-10, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “expenses prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, such as advertising or publicity costs” refers to any of the expenses falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 20, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.text_en: 3. Business promotion expenses pursuant to Article 35 of the Income Tax Act and Article 25 of the Corporate Tax Act

rows.text_en: b. Retirement benefit reserves under Article 29 of the Income Tax Act and Article 33 of the Corporate Tax Act.

rows.text_en: c. Contributions paid into a retirement pension account under Article 40-2(1)2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act and contributions to retirement pensions, etc. under Article 44-2(2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Corporate Tax Act.

rows.source_ko: 5. 별표 8의9 제2호가목에 따른 배우출연료가 가장 많은 배우 5인의 배우출연료 합계액이 제작비용 합계액(제1호에서 제4호까지의 규정에 따른 금액은 제외한다)의 100분의 30을 초과하는 경우 해당 초과 금액
rows.text_en: 5. If the sum of the acting fees of the five actors with the highest fees pursuant to Item 2, Subparagraph (a) of Annex 8-9 exceeds 30% of the total production costs (excluding amounts pursuant to the provisions of Items 1 through 4), the said excess amount
